name: ZL Comp
_comment: Insert effect: master-bus compressor on ZL Compressor's DSP (zlcomp_core.h + zldsp/). "effect": true makes gen_vst.py list it as an insert effect (as in mpc-vst-rat). vst.json/module.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin. The plugin is zlcomp_vst.cpp, built by this port's own build.sh.
